_contract: Every number appearing in the README, either architecture diagram, the Devpost description, the blog, or the video must exist in this file first, written by an instrumented run, with its measurement method named. In-process timings are never presented as deployed measurements. Estimates are labelled 'estimate' until an instrumented run replaces them. A number that was not measured is the string 'not yet measured' — never a plausible value.

_schema.value: the number, or the literal string 'not yet measured'
_schema.method: how it was produced; 'estimate' entries name the arithmetic
_schema.measured_at: ISO-8601 UTC, or null if not yet measured
_schema.surface: 'local' | 'deployed' | 'estimate' — local timings are never quoted as deployed

per_run_15_estimate.method: estimate; §1.4 arithmetic recomputed at gemini-3.6-flash rates pending a rate confirmation and an instrumented run

per_run_15_measured.method: 21 live calls executed; the dollar figure must be read from the Cloud Billing console rather than estimated from token counts, and has not been read yet

validation._note: Measured on a live 16-submission Vertex AI run (run-recorded-p2, gemini-3.6-flash + gemini-3.5-flash-lite, temperature 0).

observations_total.method: claims projection of the live run

first_attempt_acceptance_rate.method: accepted evidence observations needing no retry, over all evidence observations

entailment_disagreement_rate.method: entailment disagreements over cited observations, live run, after the KAR-310 revision cycle

entailment_disagreement_rate_before_revi.method: same measurement on prompt_version p1, before the one permitted revision cycle

entailment_branch_taken.method: p1 measured 13.5% (>8%), which entitled exactly one prompt-revision cycle under KAR-310; p2 measured 6.8%, at or below the 8% bar, so the accept branch applies

retry_distribution.method: attempts recorded on each accepted observation, plus attempt-cap escalations

cache_hit_rate_warm.method: second offline run over the same fixtures: 21 of 21 model calls served from the committed cache

model_calls_cold.method: live run with an empty cache, 16 submissions

beat_timings._note: KAR-317 requires three measurements per beat on the deployed path. The §8 seconds table uses the worst of the three, never the best or the mean.

friction._note: KAR-205. The headline claim is falsifiable only if these are measured on a real rubric with a documented method and a stated n.

measurement_is_self_timed.method: true if the pilot-instructor sessions did not happen and the disclosed self-timed fallback was used instead

fixtures._note: Measured offline by scripts/update_metrics.py. These are properties of the committed corpus and of the local pipeline, and they are labelled surface=local. They are never quoted as deployed measurements.

submissions_parseable.method: counted by freezing every file the local source discovers

submissions_unparseable.method: files that raised UnparseableSource during freeze

citable_spans_total.method: span registries minted from the frozen renditions

planted_problems_found.method: each plant re-checked against live pipeline behaviour, not against the manifest

golden_run._note: The committed reference run. Its event log is hand-constructed, not model output.

sheets.method: evidence sheets produced by the fold

terminal_outcomes.method: counted by render(); all six must be non-zero (asserted by tests/test_replay.py)

range_hash.method: hash over the content hashes of every consumed event

tests_collected.method: pytest --collect-only, default markers (no credentials, no emulator, no model calls)
